text: Welcome to my office. I understand you have been suffering from chronic joint pain; to help me diagnose the cause, could you tell me which specific joints are affected and how long you have experienced these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. The pattern of pain worsening with activity and improving with rest in a 69-year-old male suggests a mechanical or inflammatory process. Can you describe the character of the pain—is it stiff, sharp, or burning—and do you experience any morning stiffness that lasts more than 30 minutes? REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP.
